svg.text: Every step is cu_selecter() then calc_loop(), called in sequence — the two do not overlap. That is the 'dataflow collapse': one GeMV instance is time-multiplexed across all 49 steps

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: instead of five separate compute units, which is what fits 12 layers of int8 weights through a single edge-class part.
